Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: Which one of the following is not a constituent of biogas?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (d)  Nitrogen dioxide (NO2) is not a component of biogas.

Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: A mother of blood group O has a group O child. What could be the blood group of father of the child?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (b)  The blood group of father of  the child could be A or B or O.

Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: What does sphygmomanometer measure?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (a)  Sphygmomanometer is an instrument to measure the blood pressure. It is made up of an inflatable cuff to restrict the blood flow and a mercury or manometer to measure pressure.

Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: What does water gas comprise of?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (a)  Water gas is a synthetic gas, having CO and H2. The gas is produced by passing steam over a red hot hydrocarbon fuel as coke.

Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: Which   one   of   the   following   causes   the chikungunya disease?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (d)  Chikungunya is caused by chikungunya virus which is an insect borne virus of genus Alphavirus. Symptoms show high fever, maculopapular rash, headache, etc.

Biology 2007-II.question: Which one of the following vitamins is abundant in guava fruits?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (c)  Vitamin-C is enough in guava fruits. Vitamin-C helps in strengthening of immunity, serves as an antioxidant and provides relief in hypertension too. 272. Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: Which one of the following vitamins helps in clotting of blood?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (d)  Vitamin-K adds in blood clotting. Vitamin-K acts as an essential cofactor for factor-II, VII, IX, X and also for proteins Z, C and S.

Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: Which one of the following glands in the human body stores iodine?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (b)  Thyroid gland in human body contains iodine. Deficiency of iodine creates goitre disease. Which is observed by the enlargement of larynx.

Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: Which of the following diseases are preventable by vaccine?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (b)  Polio and pertusis are caused by virus. So, these can be controlled by vaccines.

Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: In the context of ecology and environment, what does the Red Data Book pertain to?
options: Details of harmful levels of various pollutants
A complete list of all endangered plants and animals
A description of the consequences of nuclear holocaust
A description of the sociological and psychological consequence of genetically modified plants and animals
Biology 2007-II.answer: A complete list of all endangered plants and animals
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (b)  Red Data Book is related with a complete list of all endangered species.

Biology 2007-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2007-II.question: Which of the following is not a bird?
Biology 2007-II.explanation: (a)  Bat is mammal not a bird.
